detail: Official pgbench-shape schema previously failed on ALTER TABLE ONLY ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... PRIMARY KEY.
FusionDB primary-key scan semantics assume the primary key maps to row storage keys, so ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY is limited to single first-column keys.
Pgbench compatibility smoke passed 6/6, including official_pgbench_schema.
Official pgbench binary is still missing from PATH; no official pgbench run has been claimed.
